trends.rule: Too early = fewer than 10 days of data or fewer than 20 events in the line. Otherwise a straight line is fitted through the daily values: Solid = the slope is clearly not flat (t of 2 or more, so the direction is consistent); Weak = too noisy to tell it from flat. Finished days only; Apple publishes a day's organic installs the next day.
